title: Sprint-week microlog — Maya Liu
content:
2026-03-13 (Fri) — quick microlog / sprint-week wrap

Top goals for the day (3):
- Finalize Dedicated capacity pricing proposal for BA review (deliverable: one-pager + slide that shows unit economics).
- Prep for 11:00 cross-functional alignment (SLO/rollback playbook talk) — need two clear rollback triggers.
- Triage exec-facing incident follow-ups and confirm owner for the postmortem draft.

Meetings / prep notes
11:00 — Cross-functional SLO alignment (Eng infra, Product, SRE) — 30m
- Attendees: Priya, Daniel (SRE), Omar (infra), Heather (product), Samir
- Objective: agree on 3 rollback triggers + canary thresholds for Dedicated launches.
- Must-have decisions: rollback latency threshold (p50/p95 delta?), error budget burn rate alarm, automatic fallback policy signoff.
- Ask: Omar to bring recent Dedicated tail-latency histogram (last 7 days), Samir to bring cost delta numbers for 2 quantization profiles.
- Quick ask to Heather: do we need business-level opt-in for automatic fallback? If yes, what customers?

09:00 — Leadership 1:1 roundup (15m)
- Quick status cadence: headcount ask delayed; push to next Tuesday.
- Action: Samir to send revised Dedicated SLA wording by EOD.

14:00 — Customer escalation review (30m)
- Read-ahead: GH issue list + support tickets from CON-2312.
- Goal: confirm root cause hypothesis and customer communication timeline.

Follow-ups / action items (explicit owners + due)
- Samir P. — draft pricing one-pager for BA review (due 2026-03-16) [PRIORITY].
- Anna G. — consolidate rollback triggers doc and add runbook link (due 2026-03-15).
- Daniel (SRE) — produce tail-latency histogram export and sample traces (due 2026-03-13 EOD).
- Maya (me) — write incident postmortem outline + assign reviewers (due 2026-03-14).
- Support Ops — confirm customer-facing statement, then schedule send (owner: Heather) (due 2026-03-13).

Personal time blocks / focus windows
- 08:30–09:00 — inbox triage: triage priority threads, flag anything >2h.
- 09:00–09:20 — leadership quicks.
- 10:00–11:00 — deep work: pricing one-pager draft (no meetings).
- 13:00–14:00 — lunch + Slack catch-up (light).
- 15:30–17:00 — PM sync + finalize slide for Monday BA.

Notes to self / shorthand reminders
- Keep pricing doc conservative: show both per-token and committed capacity numbers; include example customer profile (SaaS startup, 10M tokens/month).
- When discussing rollback thresholds, anchor to latency delta percent not absolute ms — easier to sell to product chairs.
- Postmortem: keep root cause paragraph < 3 sentences; timeline should be step-by-step w/ timestamps and owners.
- Ask SRE about enabling KV-cache sampling for a subset of requests (instrumentation idea).

Open questions / blockers
- Do we have a final legal wording on data residency opt-in for Dedicated trials? (tag: legal)
- Are there any pending infra spend approvals that could block Dedicated promos? (Finance)
- Who owns the customer-facing technical FAQ for automatic fallback? (Product or Solutions Eng?)

Quick link cheatsheet (for meeting)
- Runbook (confluence): CONFLUENCE:Ops-Runbook-2026
- Incident tickets: CON-2312
- Pricing model spreadsheet (sheet): FIN: Dedicated-pricing-2026

Rapid reflection (end-of-day capture)
- What went well: Samir moved quickly on the cost model fragments; good data in histogram sample.
- What to improve: more pre-reads next time — leadership wants concise TL;DR at the top of any doc.
- Blockers for next week: finalize legal/data residency wording, confirm capacity commit thresholds.

Todo (quick checklist)
- [ ] Finalize pricing one-pager
- [ ] Add rollback triggers to runbook
- [ ] Draft postmortem outline
- [ ] Confirm customer communication window
- [ ] Ask legal re: residency wording

Random scratch (brain-dump)
- Think: Potential small pilot with partner region eu-west-2 for Private — low risk, helps compliance ask. Cost/benefit?
- Note: follow-up with Anna on A/B rollout templates — could be reused for Dedicated canaries.

End of microlog. Keep this pared and actionable — extract into meeting read-ahead if needed.
